results.name: Resistance Band Face Pull (Back View)
instructions: Secure the middle of the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at head height. Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one handle of the band in each hand with your arms extended straight in front of you, palms facing down.
Pull the handles towards your face, bending your elbows and flaring them out to the sides until your hands are at your face sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement, keeping your upper arms parallel to the floor.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control, maintaining tension in the band. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you pull the band towards your face and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees for better balance and support.
results.description: Resistance Band Face Pull (Back View) is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps.

results.name: Reverse Machine Fly
instructions: Sit on a stool with your back straight, knees bent, and feet on the floor.
Extend your arms forward and grab the handles of the machine with your palms facing down.
Pull the handles by opening your arms wide to your sides.
As your arms are aligned with the shoulders, return to the initial position and repeat.
tips: Exhale as you pull the handles outward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Keep your elbows slightly bent to reduce strain on your joints.
Focus on engaging your upper back and shoulder muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Reverse Machine Fly is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Reverse Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing away from a hip-level box or surface.
Place your hands on the box behind you with your arms straight, palms down.
Slowly bend your knees to lower your body, keeping your arms straight and allowing your shoulders to stretch as you lower yourself.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your shoulders and chest. Slowly straighten your legs to return to the starting position.
tips: Perform the stretch on a stable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and prevent slipping.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears to maximize the stretch.
Ensure your hands are securely positioned on the box to prevent slipping.
results.description: Reverse Shoulder Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Chest.

results.name: Seated Dumbbell Neutral Grip Front Raises
instructions: Sit tall on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Don't swing the weights.
Keep your back against the pad if there is one.
results.description: Seated Dumbbell Neutral Grip Front Raises is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Chest.

results.name: Seated Dumbbell Neutral Grip Side Raises
instructions: Sit tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Don't shrug.
results.description: Seated Dumbbell Neutral Grip Side Raises is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps.

results.name: Seated Dumbbell One Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in your right hand at shoulder height, palm facing forward. Keep your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
Press the dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended overhead, keeping your wrist straight.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left arm and repeat.
tips: Avoid arching your back; keep it pressed against the backrest of the bench.
Move the dumbbell in a straight line to maximize muscle engagement.
Exhale as you press the dumbbell up and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Seated Dumbbell One Arm Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Seated Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand. Lean forward at your hips until your chest is close to your thighs, letting your arms hang down towards the floor with palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
Avoid swinging the weights or using momentum to lift the dumbbells.
results.description: Seated Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Shrugs
instructions: Sit tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Don't roll your shoulders.
Keep your arms straight.
results.description: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Shrugs is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Seated Plate Bus Drivers
instructions: Sit tall holding a weight plate at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions, arms extended at shoulder height.
Turn the plate to one side like a steering wheel.
Return to the centre and turn it to the other side.
Keep alternating with your arms at shoulder height.
tips: Keep your arms straight.
Sit tall without leaning back.
results.description: Seated Plate Bus Drivers is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core.
